scope.title: Wave 5 cross-link audit
scope.purpose: Ensure Wave 5 city-knowledge and practical-life surfaces connect users to the next useful BetterMakati record or task without restoring removed directories or duplicating canonical data.

principles: Prefer contextual links between canonical owners over duplicate summary databases.
A Wave 5 page does not need links to every other Wave 5 page; links should correspond to a real user continuation.
Dynamic entity links are preferred when the underlying record explicitly identifies a barangay, place, area, mobility system, legislation item, accountability record or City Monitor record.
Parking remains removed as a BetterMakati feature; the legacy /parking route may exist only as a compatibility redirect.

BetterGov and BetterLGU handoffs stay globally available through the footer unless a specific page has a concrete national or cross-LGU continuation. Do not add ecosystem links merely to advertise the ecosystem.

domains.note: Added generic Heritage and Explore Makati handoffs while retaining event-level place and barangay links.
Heritage collections already bridge directly to place records and filtered history.
Added Explore Makati and Getting around handoffs; canonical area cards already link to barangays and places.
Removed the stale Parking card and replaced it with Areas & districts.
Explore Makati remains the broad city-discovery hub while volatile commercial discovery stays external/live.
Each timeline item links back to its canonical owner and original source rather than duplicating the owner record.
News relationships are explicit and conservative; no headline auto-promotes into a canonical domain.

ecosystem.decision: No additional Wave 5 page-level BetterGov links are required in W5-9a because the current Wave 5 journeys are Makati-local and the existing audited ecosystem resources have no stronger task-specific continuation for History, Heritage, Estates, Mobility, Calendar or News.

removedOrBounded.rule: No Wave 5 public page, Home, navigation or Search may link to /parking. App may retain a redirect for old URLs.
Do not turn pages into generic link directories. Cross-links must correspond to a useful continuation.
BetterGov/BetterLGU links should complete a task, not explain the ecosystem architecture.

fixes: Mobility Parking card replaced with Areas & districts.
History now offers Heritage places and Explore Makati handoffs.
Estates & Districts now offers Explore Makati and Getting around handoffs.
Visitor/Explore guards updated to reflect the already-adopted split canonical/recurring rendering instead of stale string markers.
